name: Dependency-Aware Work Scheduler
purpose: Transform a bounded T26 autonomous execution loop into a deterministic dependency-aware work schedule without performing execution itself.

deep_audit.01_purpose: Create deterministic dependency-aware work schedules for bounded T26 execution loops.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Work registration, graph validation, dependency resolution, readiness, ordering, concurrency grouping, replay safety and failure handling.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T26 loop identity, work units, dependencies, budget and scheduler policy.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Immutable deterministic schedule snapshot and scheduling decision.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: T27 owns scheduler state only and does not replace canonical controller state.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: Dependency readiness is based on explicit machine-readable work state.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: T28 reconciliation, T29 human decision boundary and T30 completion handoff.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Cycle, invalid dependency, unknown dependency, budget block, replay, stale identity and corrupted scheduler state.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Identical scheduler inputs produce identical schedules and fingerprints.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Concurrency groups are calculated without executing work.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Stale or invalid schedules fail closed and may be rebuilt from authoritative inputs.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents dependency loss, ordering drift, repeated work and hallucinated readiness across chats.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Scheduler state and dependency graph are self-contained and machine-readable.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: T24 continuity identity is bound into scheduler identity.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Reads loop, work graph, dependency state and budget envelope.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Writes scheduler-owned state and immutable schedule evidence only.
deep_audit.19_testability: All graph and scheduling transitions are deterministic and independently testable.
deep_audit.20_observability: Schedule decisions expose dependencies, readiness, blocking reasons and fingerprints.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T26 provides bounded loop context and T27 produces scheduling-only output.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Conflict resolution, human decision and completion remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T27 may schedule but cannot authorize or execute.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Scheduler identity and schedule fingerprints prevent duplicate schedules.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema, policy, graph and work-unit versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Cycles, phantom dependencies, replay, starvation, resource bypass and unauthorized readiness are rejected.
